Where can I find your full shipping policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
You can find our full shipping policy on our website’s Shipping Policy page, typically linked in the footer at checkout or at the bottom of the site. If you’d like, I can also summarize the key points for domestic or international shipping here.
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Yes, we offer international shipping to most countries via APC Postal Logistics. Shipping costs vary by country and are calculated at checkout, and delivery typically takes around 25 business days due to customs processing. For customs or duties, I’d recommend checking the full Shipping Policy page or contacting our team at info@nakedwardrobe.com so they can confirm the details for your destination.
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Standard Shipping is fulfilled in 4–7 BUSINESS DAYS once the order is placed. If you need it sooner, our fastest available option is PRIORITY SHIPPING, which is fulfilled in 2–3 BUSINESS DAYS.
What's your return and refund policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Our return window is 14 DAYS AFTER DELIVERY. Items must be in ORIGINAL CONDITION, unworn or unused, with TAGS ATTACHED, in the ORIGINAL PACKAGING, and you’ll need the RECEIPT OR PROOF OF PURCHASE.
A $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund. INTERNATIONAL ORDERS (EXCEPT CANADA), INTIMATES, BODYSUITS, JEWELRY, ALL SALE/MARKDOWN ITEMS, AND GIFT CARDS are NON-RETURNABLE. Items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS are processed for STORE CREDIT ONLY.
